name: Marketplace — Gradient Window
why: The most common winning thumbnail (~40%): light browser window floating on a soft pastel gradient, filling most of the width. Modelled on Consulta and Canvasfolio. 4:3 is the Marketplace thumbnail ratio.

name: Marketplace — Blurred Hero
why: Window over a blurred version of the site's own hero, so background and site read as one brand (Kora, Consulting, Firma, Amber). Works for photo-led and dark sites.

name: Marketplace — Near Bleed
why: Closest the tool gets to the bare full-bleed hero (~24%): the site fills almost the whole card so a giant wordmark stays readable at 279 px (Neiden, Arpeggio, Rushes). Best for big-type heroes.

name: Marketplace — Studio Grey
why: Neutral grey studio backdrop used by most device shots (Lateral, Asher Vale, Perspectiva, All Natural). Laptop stands in for the monitor-on-stand look until that layout exists.

name: Marketplace — Dark 3D Tilt
why: A tilted window on a near-black, warm-tinted background (CreatorCut, Sanjaya, Spartan's). Depth stands out in a grid of flat cards. Keep the tilt under about 20° so the hero stays readable.

name: Marketplace — Brand Colour Pop
why: A solid, saturated brand colour behind a light window (ProLab, Platform, GrowthLabb). Light and saturated backgrounds pop hardest against the Marketplace's near-black page. Set c1 to the site's accent.

name: Marketplace — Soft Neutral Float
why: Quiet, premium look for minimal or editorial sites: light window, off-white→grey gradient, deeper shadow (Maelle, Overtake, Asher Vale).

name: Gallery — Desktop + Phone
why: Almost no top thumbnails use phones, but listing pages carry 3 more 4:3 gallery images. A desktop + phone pair is the natural 'it's responsive' shot for slot 2.

name: Gallery — Three Pages
why: Shows range like the collage thumbnails (Nudge, Framewell, Platform), but flat and readable. Use for gallery slots 3–4 with inner pages (About, Work, Pricing).

name: Social — OG Card
why: The same gradient-window look at 1200×630 for the template's own social share image and launch posts, so the listing and social posts match.
